source.original_question: What best describes the relationship between cosmic ray energy, tissue penetration, and health risk?

original_choices.A: Higher energy allows deeper penetration, potentially causing more cellular damage and increased cancer risk.
original_choices.B: Lower energy rays penetrate deeper, posing the greatest risk to internal organs.
original_choices.C: Energy has no effect on penetration; all cosmic rays pose an equal health risk.
original_choices.D: Only cosmic rays that cannot penetrate the skin cause significant DNA damage and health effects.
